message:
test(keepalive-r2 ②, d): two PRODUCT clients (StandbyLease + ClientSessionController) at a real host; an older host

--product-client: A and B park (no session); A connects through its activation (first session by activation, video,
its window list); B pings 12 s -- no new session, no control end, A still connected; B takes over (a new epoch,
video); A's session ends, A parks on a new socket, takes it back with a larger generation; every session the host
made came from an activation (no ordinary Hello). An older host: Unsupported, no session, no Hello. 35/35 under
sh_run -NativeExe; the existing suite (--old-host --real-directory) 89/89. Mutant: the session ignores the
handshake (always the Hello) -> 4 FAIL.
